premises.text: Most commerce still happens in physical stores where brands lack control over in-store execution despite large marketing spend
premises.evidence_span: 92% of commerce still takes place offline at physical retail stores

premises.text: Brand–retailer collaboration is broken because it relies on phone calls, emails, and expensive inefficient store visits
premises.evidence_span: Brands and retailers are still relying on multiple phone calls and emails and very expensive and inefficient store visits

premises.text: Ubique is a collaboration platform where brands monitor operations globally, retailers improve execution remotely, and store employees focus on what matters
premises.evidence_span: Brands monitor their operations globally, retailers improve their execution remotely, and in-store employees can focus on what really matters

premises.text: Campaign tools let brands build missions, push tasks to stores, and optionally use a crowdsourcing community to collect in-store data
premises.evidence_span: she can decide to use our crowdsourcing community of 50,000 consumers to collect the data on her behalf

premises.text: Real-time object detection automates continuous product-facing and share-of-shelf measurement from store photos
premises.evidence_span: Ubique uses real-time object detection to automate continuous products

premises.text: Combining sales data with merchandising info gives brands previously unavailable insights and live retailer notification
premises.evidence_span: By combining sales data with merchandising info, she has now insights that were never available before

premises.text: SaaS pricing charges per user per company
premises.evidence_span: We have a SaaS business model where we charge on a per-user, per-company basis

value.text: Better in-store execution that increases sales and merchandising ROI for brands and retailers
value.evidence_span: We've maximized the merchandising return on investment

secondary_value.text: Increased sales for customers by an average of 25%
secondary_value.evidence_span: We increased sales for our customer by an average of 25%

causal_links.evidence_span: We believe that in-store execution requires a new collaboration platform. That's why we built Ubique
in-store execution is key, but hardly happens
We've improved field efficiency. We've maximized the merchandising return on investment
